findings.statement: Authoritative effective date for Northland's GLP-1 weight-management coverage is 2024-01-01 per NL-SPA-2023-014; the provider manual NL-MAN-2024-RX states 2024-02-01 but is lower authority and conflicts.

The SPA covers GLP-1 receptor agonists for chronic weight management in adults with BMI >= 30, or BMI >= 27 with a weight-related comorbidity, and was federally approved effective January 1, 2024; type 2 diabetes coverage was unchanged.

GLP-1 prescriptions per 1,000 member-months averaged 11.8 in the four pre quarters (2023Q1-2023Q4) and 16.4 in the four post quarters (2024Q1-2024Q4), a 38.8% increase (95% CI 36.4% to 41.0%), verdict significant and material.
GLP-1 reimbursement per member per month rose from $10.9 to $15.5, a 42.4% increase (95% CI 40.1% to 44.6%), verdict significant and material.
Total GLP-1 spending rose 42.3% from $9.94M in 2023Q4 to $14.15M in 2024Q4; 91.2% of the change came from utilization per member, 8.4% from price per prescription, and 0.4% from enrollment.

Reimbursement per prescription moved only from $920.2 to $944.2 (+2.6%, 95% CI 1.3% to 4.0%), statistically significant but below the 5% materiality threshold, so the spending rise is volume-driven rather than price-driven.
